Context: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

3. Can a second charge be created on a property for which" HBA is already availed? PUS  
A Government servant who has obtained a House Building Advance from the Government is permitted to create a second charge on the property with the permission of the Head of the Department to meet the balance cost of the house / flat from recognized financial institutions.
